column1: # तल-स्नैपशॉट् — the PROVED FLOOR list, third companion to Setu/Bhitti.
# A ford prices a crossing at exactly zero.  A wall refuses an
# identification.  A FLOOR is a proved lower bound on EVERY route between
# two banks: a universally quantified statement that any map must lose at
# least the exhibited amount.  Floors are what barriers are — TARGET.md's
# parity theorem (every neutral-query method pays the parity bit) is a
# floor on the observable graph; Bombieri's sieve barrier is a floor; the
# sevenfold-to-twofold collision below is the smallest member of the class.
# A floor's identity is its declaration, keyed like the other snapshots.
